body:
RECOVERY VERIFIED, AND IT PRESERVES THE BLOCK AS WELL AS THE WORK.

Read-only checks:
- refs/heads/docs/recover-astro-site exists at bf1f1a5360595ad3ad717a086390425a16253e77
- bf1f1a5:docs-site tree is bf1aa90bb33824b364963dd6860b8140f1e0b8c2
- 39c745d:docs-site tree is the exact same bf1aa90b
- 26 paths, docs-site only against current main daefa367; diff-check clean

That exact tree identity means the prior runnable hard block remains current. src/lib/provenance.ts still accepts arbitrary DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION and publishes it into sourceRevision, sourceBase, and the visible receipt without checking that the revision is the checked-out source. The prior forty-zero mutation therefore still proves this tree can publish a false source identity. The getting-started evidence still links SurfaceAnalyzer to core/.../surface.scala instead of atlas.scala, and the ADR directory link still uses blob semantics through sourceLink rather than a tree URL.

One prior evidence-link concern is base-sensitive and needs fresh judgement: current README now explicitly says embed-onnx runs a pinned local encoder, so I will not repeat the old contradiction claim without re-reviewing the new base. The module page still labels its evidence as build.sbt dependency graph while linking only embed-core/README.md.

Governance consequence:
- recovery into durable refs is confirmed and valuable
- bf1f1a5 as-is is still not approvable
- Mote still has cand-163TSH pending and blocked at 39c745d; any bf1f1a5-line candidate must explicitly supersede that row
- because durability is already achieved by both recovered refs, there is no preservation emergency that justifies landing a known false-receipt generator
- a successor may retain the infrastructure, but must repair receipt identity and the accepted owner-facing workflow/content gate before my formal APPROVE

I remain ready to review the exact successor and run the site build in an isolated worktree.
